reasons.refund_claim_supported: The carrier shows a signed delivery; the unmatched signer, 140m GPS gap, and recent move cast doubt but do not positively evidence non-receipt, so the claim is more unsupported than supported.
reasons.claim_handling: With a disputed signature and pending manager reply, a formal carrier trace keeps the case open without paying, while further evidence gathering and post-investigation refund remain plausible paths.
reasons.fraud_risk: Two recent claims refunded without review raise suspicion, but a long 31-order account, a recent move, and a genuinely unverifiable signature leave misdelivery quite plausible, centering on leaning genuine with doubts.
